parameters.content:
## Route Intelligence Tool
**Purpose:** obtain an OSRM route and calculate a deterministic exposure score from supplied PULSE records.
**Input:** POST /webhook/pulse/route with origin, destination, locale and optional incidents/riskZones/alerts.
**Output:** normalized routes with score and warnings.
**Credentials:** none for OSRM; Google Routes is optional and should replace the provider node.
**Failure path:** returns a direct approximate route if OSRM is unavailable.

parameters.jsCode: const body = $json.body ?? $json; const origin = body.origin; const destination = body.destination; const valid = (p) => Number.isFinite(Number(p?.lat)) && Number.isFinite(Number(p?.lng)) && Math.abs(Number(p.lat)) <= 90 && Math.abs(Number(p.lng)) <= 180; if (!valid(origin) || !valid(destination)) return [{json:{invalid:true,ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_ROUTE_POINTS',message:'Origen o destino inválido.'}}}]; const url = `https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/${Number(origin.lng)},${Number(origin.lat)};${Number(destination.lng)},${Number(destination.lat)}?overview=full&geometries=geojson&alternatives=true`; return [{json:{origin,destination,locale:body.locale??'es',incidents:Array.isArray(body.incidents)?body.incidents:[],riskZones:Array.isArray(body.riskZones)?body.riskZones:[],alerts:Array.isArray(body.alerts)?body.alerts:[],url}}];

const request = $('Validate Route Request').first().json; if (request.invalid) return [{json:request}]; const response = $json; const toRad=(v)=>v*Math.PI/180; const distance=(a,b)=>{const r=6371,dLat=toRad(b.lat-a.lat),dLng=toRad(b.lng-a.lng),h=Math.sin(dLat/2)**2+Math.cos(toRad(a.lat))*Math.cos(toRad(b.lat))*Math.sin(dLng/2)**2;return r*2*Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(h),Math.sqrt(1-h));}; const records=[...request.incidents.map(x=>({...x,_weight:x.priority==='P1'?35:x.priority==='P2'?20:10})),...request.riskZones.map(x=>({...x,_weight:x.severity==='high'||x.severity==='critical'?20:10})),...request.alerts.map(x=>({...x,_weight:20}))]; let rawRoutes=Array.isArray(response.routes)?response.routes.slice(0,3):[]; if(!rawRoutes.length){const km=distance(request.origin,request.destination);rawRoutes=[{distance:km*1000,duration:(km/45)*3600,geometry:{coordinates:[[request.origin.lng,request.origin.lat],[request.destination.lng,request.destination.lat]]},fallback:true}];} const routes=rawRoutes.map((route,index)=>{const geometry=(route.geometry?.coordinates??[]).map(([lng,lat])=>({lat,lng}));const samples=geometry.filter((_,i)=>i===0||i===geometry.length-1||i%Math.max(1,Math.floor(geometry.length/20))===0);let score=0;for(const record of records){const point=record.location??record;if(Number.isFinite(Number(point.lat))&&Number.isFinite(Number(point.lng))&&samples.some(sample=>distance(sample,{lat:Number(point.lat),lng:Number(point.lng)})<=1))score+=record._weight;}score=Math.min(100,score);return{id:`route-${index+1}`,provider:route.fallback?'local':'osrm',geometry,distanceKm:Number((route.distance/1000).toFixed(1)),durationMin:Math.max(1,Math.round(route.duration/60)),riskScore:score,riskLevel:score>=50?'high':score>=20?'moderate':'low',warnings:route.fallback?['Ruta aproximada; confirma las condiciones antes de viajar.']:[]};});return [{json:{ok:true,routes,generatedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];
